better-shulker-hud.config.general.commen: Limits the maximum number of item columns per HUD row.
Limits the maximum number of visible item rows in the HUD.
Automatic mode prefers an available QuickShulker channel and otherwise uses AxShulkers. AxShulkers requires inventory opening on the server and the axshulkers.use and axshulkers.modify permissions.

Enable this option and left-drag the HUD toggle in the player inventory. It avoids item slots, the recipe book, and other screen buttons when released. Right-click to restore automatic placement; other containers use a safe docked position.
Saved screen-relative horizontal position from 0 to 10000. A value of -1 uses the automatic position.
Saved screen-relative vertical position from 0 to 10000. A value of -1 uses the automatic position.

Blacklist mode allows every item except blacklist entries. Whitelist mode allows only whitelist entries. When both lists are empty, this mode is ignored and the original food, tool, then other-item priority is used.
In whitelist mode, only items entered here may be moved into a shulker to free a slot. Accepts exact localized names or item IDs, for example Bread, Diamond Sword, or minecraft:bread.
In blacklist mode, items entered here cannot be moved into a shulker to free a slot. Accepts exact localized names or item IDs; unlisted items keep the food, tool, then other-item priority.
One-click organize will never move items listed here. Firework rockets (minecraft:firework_rocket) are excluded by default. Accepts exact localized names or item IDs.
Attempts to restock from a carried shulker when the main-hand stack is at or below this count.
Maximum number of items moved from a shulker by each automatic restock.
Game ticks between main-hand restock checks. Lower values respond faster.
Logs transfer requests, backend state, container sync, slot resolution, move results, and failure stages. Disabled by default; disable it again after reproducing and submit logs/latest.log.
better-shulker-hud.config.feature.commen: Shows the interactive carried-shulker HUD in inventory and container screens.
Shows the shulker HUD button only in the player inventory opened with E; other container screens never show it. When hidden, assign a hotkey to Show Shulker HUD.
Hides the vanilla recipe book button in the player inventory without closing an open recipe book or affecting the shulker HUD.
Automatically extracts required blocks from carried shulkers for Litematica Easy Place.
Hides the shulker container screen briefly opened by the configured backend during automated transfers.
Allows full or partial Pinyin searches for Chinese item names.
Tracks ordinary items extracted from shulkers and returns them to an available slot in their source box.
Refills low main-hand stacks and replaces a used water bucket after safely moving its empty bucket aside.
Refills consumed single-stack items that use the vanilla death-protection component, including Totems of Undying.
Refills low offhand stacks and consumed totem-like items from carried shulkers.
better-shulker-hud.config.hotkey.comment: Hold this key while clicking or dragging over player inventory slots. Defaults to Space.
Opens the Better Shulker HUD MaLiLib configuration screen.
While hovering a HUD item, moves it to the offhand. A different offhand item is swapped into an empty inventory slot. The default is F.
